# Qodo Standards

Skills that teach agents to work with Qodo Standards. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [qodo-ai/qodo-skills](https://github.com/qodo-ai/qodo-skills), at commit `b8c2185`.

Optional Qodo standards discovery and review rules/skills administration workflows.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Qodo Standards**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Qodo Standards**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install qodo-standards@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

2 skills: `qodo-get-rules`, `qodo-manage-standards`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

## Docs

- Vendor repository: https://github.com/qodo-ai/qodo-skills
